title: Mean forcing and supporting data 1
note: Available-month means within 2003–2023; values describe basin averages, not native pixel trends. Native precipitation and PET drive the climate reconstruction; CHIRPS is alternative rainfall. Actual ET, soil moisture and surface temperature provide context. Unequal product coverage is retained; no significance or causal attribution is implied.
